# Sample Restaurant v0.02

A premium, preview-safe restaurant demo for AFO Restaurant v0.02.

## Routes
- / text/html
- /health application/json
- /llms.txt text/plain
- /robots.txt text/plain
- /sitemap.xml application/xml
- /schema.json application/json

## Guardrails
- Preview only
- No production routes
- No custom domains
- No account IDs
- No secrets
